gold: Invasive squamous cell carcinoma arising in a seborrheic keratosis of the eyelid

selector.why: The presence of malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, along with mitotic figures, specifically supports the diagnosis of Squamous cell carcinoma.
